name: studio-qa-checklist
description: Acceptance-gate checklist executed by the QA gate command (tools-qa.py). critical=true items block release; others produce warnings. Edit per project; keep ids stable for reports.

gates.description: expected frame ranges fully present, correct padding and extension
every rendered frame opens and matches the declared resolution
accidental repeated renders detected (intentional holds allowed)
alpha present where required, no matte contamination, opaque borders
pixel dimensions and display aspect match the manifest
containers, manifests and editorial agree on frame rate
profiles/bit depth consistent; no silent conversions
no rapid high-contrast luminance changes unsafe for photosensitive viewers
cycles loop without visible seams when flagged as loops
declared pivots match visible registration points
text/critical elements meet contrast minimums incl. CVD simulation
text and critical action inside platform safe areas
every shipped asset has an approved usage basis (license, PD, consent)
machine, versions and checksums recorded for the build
labeled review sheets watched at speed by a human; notes logged

report.note: the gate never auto-fixes content; it validates and reports
